cand.title: 4th Digital Health Symposium 2027
cand.excerpt: Possible incremental Hotel Market if independently bookable demand is evidenced.
cand.recoveryAsk: HIGH deep research: verify dates, lodging mechanism, named lodging/meetings contact, YOTEL fit, competitor commitment.
cand.selectionWhy: 34-candidate commercial-quality queue · priority 2 · UNKNOWN · contact MISSING

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two actionable routing contacts are verified: Frédéric André, EHC Director of Information Systems, explicitly describes organizing and hosting the third symposium and publishes the fourth-edition call for projects; Caroline Bösch/Boesch, Head of Institutional Communication, is named in that call and has an official public contact address. Mikael de Rham, Director General, is an additional executive sponsor/routing lead. None is proven to control hotel contracts; programme speakers are not treated as buyers.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming fourth edition on 14 January 2027, within the requested horizon. Official EHC announcement published 19 October 2026 explicitly says “14 janvier 2027 | Le Cube, Morges”; this is the activity date, not the publication date. Arrival/coffee 13:30, introduction 14:00, aperitif/networking starts 18:00; final departure time is not published. No official 2028 edition announcement located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel constraints: weak main-event fit, conditional small ancillary-group fit. More than 300 attended in 2026, exceeding YOTEL’s stated approximately 250-person meeting ceiling; 2027 attendance is unknown. Moving the whole symposium to YOTEL is therefore not a credible current pitch. YOTEL is a Founex business-meeting/airport-corridor product, not a Morges city venue or a resort-led event proposition. Small speaker/project-team stays or separate workshops could fit only if overnight need, location acceptance and independent booking are confirmed. No evidence of delegates arriving through Geneva Airport or lodging toward Nyon/La Côte/Geneva was found. Do not forecast a 20–120-room block from attendance or assume banquet/catering capacity.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Le Cube (Beausobre), Avenue de Vertou 2C, 1110 Morges, canton of Vaud, Switzerland. Geographic classification: Morges/La Côte, outside the hotel’s core Founex–Nyon/Geneva Airport corridor; not Geneva city, Lausanne city or French Pays de Gex. This is a conference/event venue, not an incumbent hotel. The published venue assignment is verified; a signed contract has not been seen. Specific 2027 room within Le Cube is not stated; do not carry the 2026 Petra assignment into 2027.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 18 January 2024 in Morges, exact venue unverified; 16 January 2025 at Le Cube, Morges; 15 January 2026 at Le Cube, salles Petra, Morges; 14 January 2027 announced at Le Cube, Morges. This establishes consecutive January editions and repeat use of Le Cube for 2025–2027, not destination rotation. A 2028 date or move cannot be inferred.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. Official announcement says “Participation : CHF 30.– par personne”; ticket page describes “une après-midi” and “Lieu Le Cube — Avenue de Vertou 2C, 1110 Morges.” These are admission/venue details, not accommodation terms. No event-specific hotel names, room blocks, housing bureau, host hotel, lodging booking link or hotel RFP found in the reviewed official announcement and ticket materials or targeted French/English searches. Verified listed lodging hotels: none found. This does not establish that lodging is uncontracted or independently bookable. No published room-night or peak-room figure found.
findings.organizationStructure: EHC is a private nonprofit healthcare institution constituted as the association Ensemble Hospitalier de la Côte, not a sports organizer, hotel, DMC or evidenced PCO. EHC owns/organizes the symposium; the first edition was organized in partnership with Antares Consulting. That historical partnership does not establish a 2027 accommodation/procurement mandate. Le Cube is the venue; Infomaniak Events provides the ticketing page, not an evidenced housing bureau.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Cube is the published incumbent meeting venue for 2027 and was used in 2025–2026. Its venue listing describes rooms for 40–500 persons, whereas the hotel’s supplied theatre ceiling is approximately 250. No competing lodging hotel or housing-bureau commitment is evidenced, but neither is uncommitted inventory. No sold-out hotel, compression or overflow evidence was found. Do not sell an overflow story or portray the incumbent venue as a hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Caroline Boesch at the published EHC communications address, requesting an introduction to Frédéric André and the person handling symposium travel/accommodation. Ask whether any 2027 speakers or project teams need overnight rooms, who books/pays, whether lodging is already contracted, which hotels are involved, and whether Founex is acceptable. Offer a tailored ancillary stay or small workshop discussion only after positive answers; do not send a speculative whole-house/block or venue-replacement proposal. Ask about a future cycle only without assigning a 2028 date. Keep qualification on hold pending demonstrated overnight demand.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Event registration is publicly advertised at CHF 30; this permits relationship/networking access, not hotel procurement access. The meeting venue is already announced at Le Cube. A 2027 ancillary-lodging sale remains unqualified until organizers confirm actual overnight guests and who books/pays; independently bookable lodging has not been established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: recurring relationship development is more credible than a whole-event venue displacement. Repeat Morges/Le Cube use and 2026 attendance constrain a future plenary bid. Explore smaller EHC digital-health workshops, project meetings or speaker/team stays only as new needs are confirmed. No 2028 date, venue-opening, hotel tender or rotation policy is published; future capture is a strategy, not announced business.
